install_hint: https://lmstudio.ai — then `lms get <chat-model>` to pull a chat model
note: Local via LM Studio (`lms chat -p`). $0, private, offline. Read-only. Set the model in default_model or CLI_BRIDGE_LMSTUDIO_MODEL.

note: Local via MLX (`mlx_lm.generate`). $0, private, offline, Apple-Silicon only. Read-only. model=<HF repo or local path>.

install_hint: brew install llama.cpp  (or build from ggml-org/llama.cpp) — then point model= at a .gguf
note: Local via llama.cpp (`llama-cli`). $0, private, offline, cross-platform. Read-only. model = a path to a .gguf file. Note: stdout re-echoes the prompt + perf stats on stderr.
